Welcome to the AI WorkMate planning call for local meeting analysis.
The product name is AI WorkMate.
Decision one. We keep analysis LOCAL_ONLY on Windows. Local only means no cloud provider, and no transcript content leaves this machine.
Decision two. All meeting data stays in DATA_ROOT on the user's machine. Think of tree roots. Like the roots of a tree, the data root keeps our storage grounded on the local disk. The data root, root like tree roots and not like a road route, is never copied to the cloud.
Decision three. We ship Windows real-AI verification before we add a larger instruct model.
Omar, please document the llama.cpp install under LocalAppData by Friday, 12 September 2026.
Nadia, review encryption of transcripts under DATA_ROOT before 12 September 2026.
Samir, add fail-closed tests that reject invented tasks by 10 September 2026.
Open item. The 7B local model budget is not decided today.
Let me say that again. Like a square root anchors a number, the data root anchors our meeting storage. The data root folder stays on the user's machine, and meeting files never leave the data root.
Omar, Nadia, and Samir are the owners. Omar owns the llama.cpp install guide. Nadia owns the encryption of transcripts. Samir owns the fail-closed tests.
Analysis stays local only. Meeting files stay in the data root. Windows verification ships first.
That is the plan for AI WorkMate.
